reported_observation: Two export-link clicks in the in-app browser did not produce a download entry.
http_result: The real SSR request returned HTTP200 with a valid three-row CSV; twelve HTTP and access assertions passed.
diagnosis: The original trigger failed in the in-app browser despite a valid HTTP attachment response. Changing it to normal new-tab attachment navigation was followed by a successful browser download.
change: Use a normal same-origin link in a new tab with noopener noreferrer. The server attachment response selects the filename. No download attribute or Blob is used.

browser_retest.observed: The revised link saved a 699-byte CSV with three models matching the displayed values and source version.
